Seldon, Psychohistory

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-06T08:48:00+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2118626440778244164; média: videó, 25 másodperc]
Elon Musk on the life cycle of civilizations:

“You do tend to see the same patterns… civilizations go through a life cycle like an organism
Just like a human: zygote, fetus, baby, toddler, teenager… eventually it gets old and dies
The civilizations go through a life cycle
No civilization will last forever”

The only question is how long we can delay the inevitable
